description: Transfer state-machine scenarios (protocol.md 7). Replay `steps` in order against a board configured with `board` (deep-merged with the scenario's `board` overrides; null removes a feature). `request` steps: send `hex` (decoded: `logical`); the board must send exactly the `expect` messages, in order (responses and XFER_ACK events). Other ops: `disconnect`, `reboot` (power cut: RAM lost, storage kept), `set_battery` (`battery` null = no battery reader; pct null = reading failed). Storage accounting of the reference board: free = storage_total - sum of stored file sizes, where an installed asset with a version also stores the version string (its length in bytes). Firmware `image_status` is what the board's image/signature check returns. The app can replay its side of each scenario: encode every request to `hex` and decode every expected message.

scenarios.name: asset_install
scenarios.description: Install a theme asset: acks every ack_window bytes and at the end, then it is listed with its version.

scenarios.name: resume_after_disconnect
scenarios.description: A disconnect journals the offset; the old handle is dead and XFER_BEGIN with the same parameters resumes with the prefix CRC.

scenarios.name: resume_after_reboot
scenarios.description: After a reboot only the journaled offset (every journal_every bytes) survives; data after it is sent again.

scenarios.name: resume_restart_flag
scenarios.description: restart=true discards the journaled data (e.g. prefix_crc32 did not match the app's file) and starts at 0.

scenarios.name: changed_file_starts_over
scenarios.description: Same id but a different size/crc32/sha256: no resume, the old data is discarded.

scenarios.name: other_target_discards_journal
scenarios.description: BEGIN for another asset discards the journaled transfer.

scenarios.name: bad_offset
scenarios.description: Chunks must arrive in order; the ack carries the expected offset.

scenarios.name: chunk_past_end
scenarios.description: Data beyond size is refused with TOO_LARGE; after FINISH chunks get NO_SESSION.

scenarios.name: finish_early
scenarios.description: FINISH before all bytes arrived is BAD_OFFSET and the session continues.

scenarios.name: crc_mismatch
scenarios.description: Declared crc32 does not match the data: CRC_MISMATCH, nothing installed, the session is failed and its data deleted.

scenarios.name: sha_mismatch
scenarios.description: Declared sha256 does not match: HASH_MISMATCH; a correct retry installs.

scenarios.name: image_invalid
scenarios.description: Integrity is fine but the asset container header is wrong (asset-formats.md).

scenarios.name: app_icon_install
scenarios.description: App icons (asset_type app_icon, 24x24 mono1 as advertised in asset_support) named app_icon_id(app_id) install like any asset, are listed, and ASSET_DELETE removes them.

scenarios.name: app_icon_wrong_size
scenarios.description: An app_icon must be exactly the advertised width x height (24x24): other sizes, or a payload that does not match them, are IMAGE_INVALID at FINISH; a file above max_size is TOO_LARGE at BEGIN.

scenarios.name: lcd_app_icon
scenarios.description: Since 0.8.0: an LCD app icon (32x32 rgb565a8) installs; other sizes, a payload that does not match 3 * width * height, and a format the board does not list are IMAGE_INVALID at FINISH.

scenarios.name: background_rgb565
scenarios.description: Since 0.8.0: a `background` + `rgb565` image is exactly the display size, 2 bytes per pixel (a tiny 8x4 display keeps the vector small; LCD is 296x240).

scenarios.name: abort
scenarios.description: XFER_ABORT discards the data; the handle is dead afterwards.

scenarios.name: begin_rejections
scenarios.description: XFER_BEGIN checks in protocol.md 7.2 order; rejected requests change nothing.

scenarios.name: no_space
scenarios.description: size above free storage is NO_SPACE; bytes of a journaled transfer that would be discarded count as free.

scenarios.name: busy
scenarios.description: Another target while receiving is BUSY; the same target resumes on a new handle.

scenarios.name: replace_and_delete
scenarios.description: Installing the same type+id replaces it atomically; without a version none is listed; ASSET_DELETE removes it.

scenarios.name: asset_list_paging
scenarios.description: ASSET_LIST pages by offset/limit in a stable order.

scenarios.name: firmware_update
scenarios.description: Firmware transfer: newer version, battery fine, image accepted.

scenarios.name: firmware_version_rejected
scenarios.description: Same, older, missing or invalid versions are refused (semver precedence: a pre-release is older than its release).

scenarios.name: firmware_downgrade_allowed
scenarios.description: A development board configured to allow downgrades.

scenarios.name: firmware_battery_gate
scenarios.description: LOW_BATTERY below the threshold unless on external power; FINISH rechecks and can be retried.

scenarios.name: firmware_battery_unknown
scenarios.description: A board with a battery reader that cannot read the level refuses.

scenarios.name: firmware_no_battery_reader
scenarios.description: Boards without a battery reader skip the battery gate.

scenarios.name: firmware_image_rejected
scenarios.description: The image/signature check fails at FINISH.

scenarios.name: firmware_resume_after_reboot
scenarios.description: Firmware resumes from the journal after a reboot.

scenarios.name: firmware_unsupported
scenarios.description: A board without OTA support.
